PURCHASE YOUR TICKET

To purchase a 5 In-A-Line ticket, go to a vending machine or any counter where Lottery is sold to ask the clerk for a ticket.

How to Choose Your Numbers:

This game is Quick Pick only. Five numbers, each from zero to nine, will be randomly generated for you.

Each play costs $1 and gives you a chance to win up to $5,000*!

You can choose to play for one drawing up to fifteen consecutive drawings, and you also have the option to choose an add-on to increase your prize.

Then, your ticket will print with your Quick Pick numbers on it.

 

INCREASE YOUR PRIZES WITH SUPER BONUS

When you play 5 In-A-Line you can add on Super Bonus for $1 per play.

Adding Super Bonus gives you a chance to multiply your prize by 1X, 2X, 3X, 4X, or 5X. At the very end of the drawing, a multiplier will be selected and will apply to any 5 In-A-Line prize you win in that drawing.

 

HOW TO WIN

During each hourly drawing**, five winning numbers*** will be selected. Match 1 to 5 numbers in the exact drawn order sequence to the drawn 5-digit number to win.

 

HOW TO CHECK WINNING NUMBERS

You can watch the hourly drawings on the Players Club app or online at ArizonaLottery.com.

 

ABOUT WINNING
HOW TO CLAIM YOUR WINNINGS

All Arizona Lottery retailers will redeem prizes up to $100, and may redeem prizes up to $599. See full details about How to Claim Prizes.

 

5 IN-A-LINE FAQS
WHAT ARE THE ODDS OF WINNING 5 IN-A-LINE

Overall odds of winning a prize are 1 in 10.

WHEN ARE 5 IN-A-LINE DRAWINGS HELD?

Drawings are held daily every 60 minutes. The first draw of the day is at 4:30 AM Arizona time and the last draw is at 11:30 PM Arizona time.

HOW OFTEN CAN I PLAY MY NUMBERS?

You can play for up to 15 consecutive drawing dates on the same ticket. Just tell the cashier at the time of your purchase or select the Multi Draw box on the vending machine.

HOW LONG DO I HAVE TO CLAIM A 5-IN-A-LINE PRIZE?

You have 180 days from the date of the drawing to claim a prize. Once a ticket has expired, it cannot be redeemed even if it is a winner.

WHAT HAPPENS IF MULTIPLE PEOPLE WIN THE MAXIMUM PRIZE?

The players will share the prize in equal amounts.*

WHERE DO I FIND THE DRAW ID?

Draw IDs appear on each Quick Draw ticket purchased in the bottom right-hand corner. If you purchased a ticket for more than one drawing, a range of Draw IDs will be included on the ticket. For Example: DRAW ID 10001 or, DRAW ID 10001 THRU DRAW ID 10015

 

DISCLAIMERS

*Prizes will be pari-mutuel when the total prize for matching 5/5 with 5X multiplier drawn is above $25,000. The total prize shall be split into equal shares, one share for each winning $1.00 played, rounded down to the nearest dollar. The prize amount per winner is the prize amount per share times the bet amount.

**5-in-a-Line can be played from 4:00 AM to 11:59 PM Arizona time, seven days a week with the first draw time at 4:30 AM Arizona time. Players have until 11:59 PM Arizona time on each day to purchase 5-in-a-Line tickets. The last drawing for 5-in-a-Line will be at 11:30 PM Arizona time.

***Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.
